Class NotFoundELResolver

java.lang.Object
jakarta.el.ELResolver
jakarta.servlet.jsp.el.NotFoundELResolver
public class NotFoundELResolver extends jakarta.el.ELResolver
The final resolver of the Jakarta Pages ELResolver chain. It always resolves the requested value, returning null when it does so.
Since:
JSP 3.1

  • Method Details

    • getValue

      public Object getValue(jakarta.el.ELContext context, Object base, Object property)
      Obtain the value of the given property on the given object using the given context.

      Resolves the property and always returns null unless the provided context contains a Boolean object with value Boolean.TRUE as the value associated with the key jakarta.servlet.jsp.el.NotFoundELResolver.class in which case an exception is thrown. This is to support implementation of the errorOnELNotFound page/tag directive.

      Specified by:
      getValue in class jakarta.el.ELResolver
      Parameters:
      context - The EL context for this evaluation
      base - The base object on which the property is to be found
      property - The property whose value is to be returned
      Returns:
      Always null
      Throws:
      jakarta.el.PropertyNotFoundException - if the provided context contains a Boolean object with value Boolean.TRUE as the value associated with the key jakarta.servlet.jsp.el.NotFoundELResolver.class
